draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Hubballi-Dharwad! Just down the road at Unkal is an 11th-century Chalukyan Shiva temple built with a doorway facing each of the four directions.
draft.hungryLine: This is North Karnataka food country, so look for jowar rotti, badanikai palya and red chilli chutney at a local khanavali.

moodReplies.show-me-around: KLE Technological University is an 18 min walk, and the old Chandramauleshwara Temple at Unkal is a short drive away.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Grab a coffee at Seven Beans in Vidyanagar, where the local youngsters hang out.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Nearby Bengeri is home to the Khadi Gramodyog unit that's the only official, authorised maker of the Indian flag in the whole country.

spots.name: KLE Technological University
spots.detail: 18 min walk · The main campus, once BVB College

spots.name: Chandramauleshwara Temple
spots.detail: Short drive · 11th-century Shiva temple at Unkal

spots.name: Nrupatunga Betta
spots.detail: Short drive · A hill with a panoramic view over Hubli city

tips.title: Eat at a khanavali.
tips.body: These local eateries serve authentic North Karnataka meals, and there are plenty of them.

tips.title: Cool off with sugarcane juice.
tips.body: You can get it all over Hubli and Dharwad in every season.

story.title: A four-door temple
story.body: The Chandramauleshwara Temple at Unkal was built in the 11th century in the Chalukyan style. It once had a four-faced linga at the centre and blends Shaiva, Vaishnava, Shakta and Vedic art.

story.title: A college is born
story.body: The KLE Society of Belagavi founded an engineering institute here in 1947. It was known as B.V. Bhoomraddi College of Engineering and Technology.

story.title: School under the hill
story.body: Kendriya Vidyalaya No.1 opened in 1965 at the foot of Nrupatunga Betta. It was set up for the children of Central Government employees and others in Hubli.

story.title: A university at last
story.body: The old BVB college was upgraded to KLE Technological University under a 2012 Act. The Hubballi campus is its main one.

story.title: A student neighbourhood
story.body: Vidyanagar is packed with colleges and the big Karnataka Medical College and Research Institute, the largest multi-specialty hospital in North Karnataka. Expect cafes and lots of young people.

food.name: Seven Beans
food.detail: Great coffee, free Wi-Fi and a little library

food.name: Abhiman hotel
food.detail: Opposite the KIMS main gate. Try the natti chicken or neer dosa

food.name: The Hans Hotel
food.detail: Opposite BVB College. Indian, Continental and Chinese, plus a lounge bar
